entities.summary: Kennedy Valentine Burke, also known as Beren Burke, is an American-Turkish professional basketball player for the New York Liberty of the Women's National Basketball Association (WNBA) and for ÇBK Mersin of the Turkish Super League. She was drafted by the Dallas Wings in the 2019 WNBA draft, and has played for the Indiana Fever, Seattle Storm, and the Washington Mystics in the WNBA.
